content: Tana Abaram ziŋan kusiini mi lutuunu Lot tikam koroŋ kizin ta boozomen ma tizem Aikuptu, mi timiili ma timar mini pa lele pakaana ki Negeb.
Abaram, ni mbio uunu kat. Pa ni le mbili mi pat milmilŋan boozo.

To Abaram izem lele ki Negeb, mi imaŋga mini mi izirri i ma ila ipet lele ta imbot la kar Betel mi kar Ai mazwan, mi isuŋ pa Merere su tana. Pa lele tana, ta muŋgu ni ipun su pa mi ipo patoronŋana muriini.
Lot, ta ziru Abaram tiwwa na, ni le mbili boozo, mi wal kini ziŋan zin mbesooŋo kini boozomen tomini.
Tana Abaram ziru Lot, len koroŋ boozo kat, mi toono irao be ziru timbot la mbata na som.
To Lot mbesooŋo kini mi Abaram mbesooŋo kini timaŋga mi tiparzooro. (Indeeŋe tana zin wal ki Kanaan mi zin wal ki Peres, zin tomini timbotmbot lele tana.)
Tabe Abaram iso pa Lot ma iso: “Ituru toŋmatiziŋ tau. Tana leleŋ be ketende malmal par piti pepe. Mi mbesooŋo kiti tomini, tiparzooro pepe.
Lutuŋ re. Toono biibi ta imbotmbot i. Tana itum re lem lele pakaana sa be mbot pa, mi nio leŋ pakaana. Nu sombe sulae, nako aŋsalae. Mi sombe lelae, nako aŋperae.”

Tona Lot mataana ila mi itiiri lele. Ni ire la pa lele keteeneŋana ta yok Yordan imbot pa ma ila imiili su kar Zoar na. Toono tana ambaiŋana kembei ta mokleene ki Merere mi kembei ta toono kizin Aikuptu. Paso, indeeŋe tana Merere ipasaana kar Sodom mi kar Gomora zen.
Tana Lot ziru Abaram tiparzem zin, mi timbot la mbata mini som. Pa Lot ikam le toono keteeneŋana ta igarau pa yok Yordan na, mi imaŋga be izirri i ma ila pa zoŋ uunu.
Tana Abaram, ni imbotmbot toono Kanaan. Mi Lot, ni imbotmbot toono keteeneŋana ta igarau pa kar Sodom na.
Indeeŋe mazwaana tana, zin tomooto mi moori ki kar Sodom tikamam mbulu bozboozo ma tisosor biibi kat pa Merere mataana.
Lot izem Abaram, mana Merere iso pa Abaram. Iso: “Kozo mender mi motom lela, pera, sula, sala, mi tiiri lele.
Toono boozomen ta re i, ina aŋkam pu mi popoŋana ku be kombotmbot pa mi iseeŋge iseeŋge ma ila.
Mi nio ko aŋkam popoŋana ku ma tipet ma tiwe munŋaana ka tieene kembei ta ululu toono kana i. Tomtom tasa ko irao be inin zin na som.
Tana maŋga mi pa pa lele ta boozomen tiŋgi mi tiiri. Pa iŋgi, aŋkam ma iwe lem.”
Tana Abaram imaŋga mini, mi izirri i ma ila ipet kar Ebron, to ipun su lele ta zaana Mamre. Lele tana ke bibip timbotmbot pa. Mi ipo patoronŋana muriini pa Merere isu tana.
